the skill holds formal.run only; formal.cover is held by the formal verification skill
formal.cover is held by the formal verification skill
with mode prove a pass is reported as every property proven
with bmc a pass is reported as no counterexample within the depth, 'not a proof'
the metrics carry a proven flag that is 1 only for a passing proof (set only when the setup names a mode)
the bmc summary and the proven flag are tested: bmc passes as bounded and does not meet the formal gate
a run that did not pass is reported as not finished or failed, never as a proof (an UNKNOWN status with no failed assertion reads 'did not finish')
the setup is read for its mode and depth
the depth is 20 when the setup gives none
formal.run takes a single-task setup: a setup that declares [tasks] is refused and nothing runs
the [tasks] refusal is part of formal.run's own check
a multi-task setup is refused with a reason
the check step is to confirm mode prove in the log and the 'every property proven' summary
the vacuity check is formal.cover and a proof that passes formal.run can still be vacuous
a sentence about the card: abstraction is reviewed and state explosion is a named failure
